title: Beginner's Guide: How To Swing Dance (No Experience Needed)

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses an encouraging, step-by-step approach focused on social dancing without strict technique. He clearly distinguishes roles for men and women while keeping explanations accessible for beginners.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the lesson and lists the steps.
The teacher explains the social swing concept and side step.
The teacher adds counts to the side step.
The teacher shows the side step from a reverse angle with body weight changes.
The teacher introduces the rock step backward.
The teacher explains footwork differences for men and women.
The teacher combines side steps with rock steps.

metaphors: rocking from side to side like in social dancing
common_mistakes: Just tapping instead of changing body weight

steps_taught.name: Side Step
steps_taught.description: Stepping side to side with body weight shift.

steps_taught.name: Rock Step
steps_taught.description: Rocking back and forward with alternating lead/follow legs.

what_works: Clear verbal contrast between leader and follower footwork
Repetition of counts and movements from both front and back angles
what_hinders: A lack of music during the practice segments makes timing feel dry

quotes.text: how to dance the most simple dances
This is what we're teaching you, is not a technique, it's just social dancing.
today's lesson is not about technique, it's just about social way
